q0697: Too many false-positive phishing reports → better awareness training that teaches the real indicators, not more simulations.
q0698: Secure remote access with one public IP and no network redesign = IPSec VPN.
q0699: Protect data but keep it recoverable = tokenization (reversible through the vault). Hashing is one-way.
q0700: Encrypt ALL the data on a laptop = full disk encryption.
q0701: A known vulnerability on a server → patch it.
q0702: Company-owned, locked down, business use only = COBO.
q0703: Many employees clicked a link without thinking → social engineering training.
q0704: Disable a protocol such as SMBv1 across many Windows servers at once = GPO.
q0705: Data in transit between sites → encryption (TLS or IPSec).
q0706: Segmented servers reachable only through an authorized internal path = jump server.
q0707: Build the vulnerability list first with automated scanning; penetration tests go deeper later.
q0708: Block or challenge traffic from high-risk regions = IP geolocation (geo-blocking).
q0709: Resume operations as fast as possible = hot site.
q0710: Leaving a screen readable at home = an OPSEC failure: lock screens and watch who can see.
q0711: The breach started with a click → user awareness training addresses the root cause.
q0712: Building a security program: first update policies and handbooks so the expectations are written down.
q0713: First hardening step for a new server: close unnecessary ports and services.
q0714: One server overloaded while others sit idle → add a load balancer.
q0715: Right to be forgotten = erase all of the person's data. Encrypted or obfuscated data still exists.
q0716: XSS against a web server → WAF (with input validation and output encoding).
q0717: Successful injection attacks → input validation (and parameterized queries).
q0718: Rapidly collect and analyze host and network data from compromised systems = EDR.
q0719: OS exploits reach below every application, exposing the whole system.
q0720: Harden end-user devices: FDE (protects the data) + endpoint protection (protects the running system).
q0721: Physically isolated from every network = air-gapped.
q0722: A personal relationship influencing a purchase approval = conflict of interest.
q0723: Automate data sharing between systems = API.
q0724: Outdated OS + infections → patch first; the malware exploits known vulnerabilities.
q0725: Response time, escalation and performance metrics = SLA.
q0726: Limit a group's logins to set hours = a GPO with logon-hour (time-of-day) restrictions.
